_note: v2.4 plan 01 T1 red fixture (no backend). ST 1.19.0 ONLY: deleteMessage removes the tool-call rows before a reply in the same event (getMessageDeletionStartId, host-facts 01-H3); 1.18.0 splices one message per event, so there this row is blocked (X4) and the step after host_delete says so. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-01-toolcall-run.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088. Line 0 is consumed and recorded; a tool-call row (is_system + extra.tool_invocations) and the reply it produced are inserted, then three more player lines are consumed one boundary each. Deleting the reply removes the tool row with it: one MESSAGE_DELETED with chat length 4 for two removed messages starting at 1. Before the T1 fix the rollback starts at 4 and keeps the boundary that read the removed run (lit_lamp): stateEquals FAILS (red). After the fix the decoder names start 1, count 2.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so every message id below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (!state || state.activeCheckpointId !== 'start') throw new Error(`the story did not load at start: ${JSON.stringify(state && state.activeCheckpointId)}`); return { cadence: 0, boundary: state.boundary };

steps.send: I take the brass key from the hook.

extract.debugResponse:
DELTA q=took_key value=true evidence="I take the brass key"
FACT importance=2 text="The player carries the brass key." evidence="I take the brass key from the hook."

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (ctx.chat.length !== 1) throw new Error(`expected only the first player line before the tool run, found ${ctx.chat.length} message(s)`); const now = Date.now(); const tool = { name: 'DM Narrator', is_user: false, is_system: true, send_date: `v24-01-tool-${now}`, mes: 'Looked up the lamp.', extra: { tool_invocations: [{ id: 'v24-01-tool', displayName: 'Look up', name: 'look_up', parameters: '{}', result: 'An oil lamp hangs by the door.' }] } }; const reply = { name: 'DM Narrator', is_user: false, is_system: false, send_date: `v24-01-reply-${now}`, mes: 'An oil lamp hangs by the door, unlit.', extra: {} }; for (const message of [tool, reply]) { ctx.chat.push(message); ctx.addOneMessage(message); } await ctx.saveChat(); return { toolRow: ctx.chat.length - 2, reply: ctx.chat.length - 1 };

steps.send: I light the oil lamp by the door.

extract.debugResponse:

FACT importance=2 text="The oil lamp by the door is lit." evidence="I light the oil lamp by the door."

FACT importance=2 text="The map lies unrolled on the table." evidence="I unroll the map on the table."

extract.debugResponse:
DELTA q=opened_chest value=true evidence="I open the iron chest"
FACT importance=2 text="The iron chest stands open." evidence="I open the iron chest with the key."

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat; const state = rt.getEngineState(); const values = state.blackboard.values; if (chat.length !== 6 || !chat[1].is_system || !Array.isArray(chat[1].extra?.tool_invocations) || chat[2].is_user || !String(chat[3].mes).includes('oil lamp')) throw new Error(`the chat is not line, tool row, reply, three lines: ${JSON.stringify(chat.map((m) => ({ mes: m.mes, is_system: m.is_system, is_user: m.is_user })))}`); if (state.lastMessageId !== 5) throw new Error(`the engine consumed up to message ${state.lastMessageId}, expected 5`); for (const key of ['took_key', 'lit_lamp', 'found_map', 'opened_chest']) if (values[key] !== true) throw new Error(`${key} did not land before the delete: ${JSON.stringify(values)}`); return { values, active: state.activeCheckpointId, boundary: state.boundary };

const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat; if (chat.length === 5) throw new Error('blocked, not failed: this host removed only the reply (1.18.0 deleteMessage splices one message per event, host-facts 01-H3), so this row does not apply here'); if (chat.length !== 4 || chat.some((m) => Array.isArray(m.extra?.tool_invocations))) throw new Error(`the reply and its tool row were not removed together: ${JSON.stringify(chat.map((m) => m.mes))}`); return { lines: chat.map((m) => m.mes) };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const state = rt.getEngineState(); const fallbacks = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((e) => /message delete/.test(e.summary)).map((e) => e.summary); if (fallbacks.length) throw new Error(`the tool-call run was not decoded exactly: ${JSON.stringify(fallbacks)}`); if (state.lastMessageId !== 0) throw new Error(`the engine still claims message ${state.lastMessageId} as consumed; the lines after the removed run would never be read again`); return { lastMessageId: state.lastMessageId, values: state.blackboard.values };
